title: Archive photo montage into blue-glow UI tour
summary: Fast black-and-white office photos set up the struggle, a typed line on black turns the corner, then a blue-lit product tour: laptop push-in, multiplayer editor, a glowing button flipping in edge-on, a post, URL, mark.
use_when: A founder or startup-program launch that opens on the hard, human side before showing the tool
A video or design tool with collaboration and an export step to show
A silent autoplay film that needs one strong colour (electric blue) to carry the product half
Contrasting a grey past with a lit present in one film

look.type_style: medium-weight grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; statements small (about 3 % H) centred on black; URL and closing words the same size; button label bold about 8 % H

sfx.event: each archive photo cut in the opening montage
statement words and URL characters appear
white flash into the large mark

structure.shot: montage: 6 cuts, avg 0.22 s; black-and-white office and co-working photos, inset about 55 % W on black
structure.camera: static frame per photo; photo size changes cut to cut (55-75 % W)
structure.motion: none inside shots; cuts at f3, f10, f15, f21, f29, f39 (the cut is the animation)

structure.shot: one archive group photo of an early team in a cramped lab, black-and-white, held
structure.motion: photo holds 32 fr; no element motion

structure.shot: black: product wordmark small centred, then a 4-word statement builds word by word; a 2-word line with an emoji sticker flying through and a labelled cursor
structure.camera: static; soft grey radial glow behind the text fades up 3.77-4.00
structure.motion: wordmark hard-cut in, holds 19 fr; words blur-in one per cell, easings.outExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s), 1 word every 7-8 fr; line re-centres as it grows; second line words blur-in, rocket sticker crosses with a flame trail 5.00-5.75, cursor with name tag glides in springs.ui (overshoot not measurable); line dims to ~0.6 at 6.00

structure.shot: laptop at a 3/4 angle in the dark, screen blue light streaks, a dock of 5 app tiles with the product tile in the middle
structure.camera: push-in 1.00 -> 1.15 over 47 fr, easings.outQuint; slight depth blur at the start clears by 6.77
structure.motion: screen keeps its light streaks drifting; tiles static

structure.shot: pull-out reveals the screen sits inside an editor: layer list left, inspector right, timeline with clip bars below; three coloured name-tag cursors move over it
structure.camera: pull-out 1.15 -> 1.00 over 15 fr springs.cameraOut, then drift up and left about 3 px/fr @1920
structure.motion: three cursors (pink, blue, green) wander on springs.ui paths, 20-40 px per 0.25 s; playhead moves along the timeline; clip bars glow orange

structure.shot: black with a blue radial glow: a glossy glowing button seen edge-on as a thin vertical sliver, rotates to face camera and reads one action word
structure.camera: static; the button travels from upper centre down to centre while it turns
structure.motion: 9.77 motion-blurred zoom into the editor; 10.00 sliver drops from top in 15 fr easings.outExpo; Y rotation 90 -> 0 deg over 54 fr (10.50-12.27) easings.inOutSine; settles springs.heavy, slight 3D tilt drift 12.27-13.00

structure.shot: the button becomes the main action button in the top bar of a dark settings panel (badge, two icons, project name field), panel tilted in perspective
structure.camera: drift: panel slides left about 4 px/fr @1920 and grows 1.00 -> 1.02
structure.motion: panel holds; button keeps its glow; no new elements

structure.shot: large white product mark on a blue card fills the frame, then shrinks into the media slot of a social post with a view counter
structure.camera: pull-out: mark card from about 95 % W to 50 % W in 9 fr springs.cameraOut, then 50 % -> 45 % by 16.00
structure.motion: 2 fr white flash at f442; mark card frame-in-frame into the post; blue card fades to black over 20 fr; view counter under the media rolls up continuously (3 digits -> 5 digits by 16.00)

structure.shot: inside the post: the product name types out to the left of the mark until mark and name form one lockup
structure.camera: drift: post grows 1.00 -> 1.05 and recentres (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: name characters appear about 2 per 0.25 s while the mark slides right and then is replaced by the last letters (±0.25 s); view counter keeps climbing

structure.shot: a glowing screen-source toolbar pill (close, three source options) sits in the post media; a pointer clicks one option; pull-out to a monitor on a desk with blue backlight and a plant
structure.camera: pull-out 1.00 -> 0.55 over 60 fr, easings.inOutSine, drifting up about 1 px/fr @1920
structure.motion: toolbar blur-in 8 fr (±0.25 s) with blue rim glow; pointer travels to the second option springs.ui and clicks at 17.77 (±0.25 s); toolbar fades as the room appears; backlight grows

structure.shot: on the monitor, the post media shows a 4-word statement one word at a time, each replacing the last, then two words together
structure.motion: one word per 0.25-0.5 s, replace in place, no transition (±0.25 s); final 2-word phrase holds 10 fr

structure.shot: black: the product URL with a path types out centred, small white type
structure.motion: typewriter about 1 char per 2 fr (22 chars over ~45 fr), line re-centres as it grows; holds 23 fr

structure.shot: the product mark alone, small (about 7 % H), white, centred on black
structure.motion: mark hard-cut in, holds 60 fr to the end; no glow

params.brand: brand.json: mark, wordmark, accent (the blue glow), bg black, display font
params.content.photos: 6-7 black-and-white archive or office photos; the last one holds about 1 s
params.content.statement: brand name + a 3-4 word claim, built word by word
params.content.subline: 2-word line with an emoji sticker and a named cursor
params.content.editorUi: rebuilt editor screen: layers, inspector, timeline, 3 named cursors
params.content.buttonLabel: one action word on the flipping glowing button
params.content.panel: settings panel top bar the button lands in
params.content.post: social post card that frames the mark, with a climbing view counter
params.content.toolbar: small screen-source toolbar with 3 options, one clicked
params.content.closingWords: 4-word phrase shown word by word on the monitor
params.content.url: URL with a path, typed on black

notes: Silent reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Measured from 4 fps sheets plus 30 fps strips at 11.00 and 14.50 s. The opening is a cut-paced photo montage (6 cuts in 1.3 s); after that the film has only 3 cuts in 23 s and moves by camera and match-cuts. The 3D button turn from edge-on (proposed term edge-on flip) has no studio component. Flash at 14.73 is 2 fr white. Photos are monochrome (proposed term mono-archive). Colour only enters at 6.20: grey past, blue present.
